product.title: Companion Tee
product.description: A premium 100% cotton t-shirt embroidered with the wedding date and vintage motif of Moose Charlap and Sandy Stewart, made in Portugal.

dossier.headline: The Companion Tee In Cream
dossier.summary: The Companion Tee is a 100% cotton T-shirt made in Portugal by the American luxury brand BODE, founded by Emily Adams Bode Aujla in 2016. It is embroidered with the December 30th, 1962 wedding date and a vintage motif of Moose Charlap and Sandy Stewart, reflecting the brand's focus on storytelling and memory in clothing.

facts.label: Detail
facts.value: Embroidered wedding date and vintage couple motif

story.title: A Marriage Remembered in Thread
story.detail: The tee is embroidered with the wedding date and a vintage motif of a couple: Moose Charlap and Sandy Stewart, married December 30th, 1962 in the penthouse of the St. Moritz Hotel overlooking Central Park.

story.title: Storytelling as a Design Language
story.detail: BODE is defined by its focus on storytelling, craft, and American history, often building garments from antique and traditional textiles as one-of-a-kind pieces.

story.title: A Menswear Milestone
story.detail: In February 2017 Emily Adams Bode Aujla became the first female designer to show at New York Fashion Week's dedicated menswear shows.

references.title: Emily Adams Bode Aujla
references.detail: American fashion designer and founder of BODE, who studied menswear design at Parsons and previously worked at Marc Jacobs and Ralph Lauren.

references.title: Antique Textile Practice
references.detail: BODE became known for garments made from antique and newly made traditional textiles, treating clothing as heirlooms.

references.title: CFDA Recognition
references.detail: BODE and Emily Bode have received industry awards, including CFDA laureate status noted in brand profiles.

dossier.lookbookStyle: Warm natural daylight, soft film grain, muted heritage palette, calm domestic and studio settings evoking memory and craft.
dossier.lookbookPrompt: A single editorial lookbook sheet in one 3:2 landscape image, arranged as a strict 2x2 grid (2 rows x 2 columns) of four landscape photographs, identical cell sizes, uniform hairline gutters, grid flush to all four edges with no outer margin. Cell 1 (top-left): a close crop of the cream BODE Companion Tee's embroidered couple motif and wedding date. Cell 2 (top-right): a man wearing the tee untucked with relaxed cream trousers in warm window light. Cell 3 (bottom-left): the tee layered under an open workwear jacket, three-quarter angle in a sunlit courtyard. Cell 4 (bottom-right): a seated figure in the tee and vintage denim against a plaster wall. In each cell the product fills about two thirds of the frame. All frames share warm natural daylight, soft film grain, and a muted heritage palette. No text, captions, numbers, watermarks, rounded corners or drop shadows.
